sections.name: Hero Video Intro
sections.sectionMetadataReason: Hero block has its own intrinsic background/video styling, not section-level container styling

sequences.reasoning: Complex hero with large typographic heading, CTA button, and embedded YouTube video with custom controls. This is NOT simple typing - it requires video embedding, custom player controls, and specific layout.
Large statement paragraph is just text content with prominent styling. Author can type a paragraph normally; the visual emphasis is a CSS concern, not a structural block need.

Side-by-side layout with image on left and text content (title, paragraphs, CTA button) on right. Requires structured two-column layout that cannot be achieved with default content flow. Obvious match with columns block.
Section heading 'WORK' and a CTA link 'View all work' - author can type heading and link normally.

Masonry grid of 5 case study items with structured repeating pattern: each has media (video/image), brand name, category tags, hover overlay description. This is a structured repeating pattern requiring block decoration for grid layout and hover effects.
Text divider with 'Solutions' label is a simple horizontal rule or separator - can be default content with styling.
Large heading 'HOW WE INVENT GROWTH' - author can simply type a heading.

Numbered interactive list of 4 solutions with hover-revealed descriptions and images. Each item has structured content (number, title, description, image, link). This is a repeating structured pattern requiring block decoration for the interactive hover behavior and numbered layout.
Side-by-side layout with image (framework diagram) and text content (title, paragraph, filled CTA button). Same pattern as Section 3 - requires structured two-column layout.

Horizontally scrolling carousel with 4 slides, each containing bold title text, background image, and statistics text. Interactive component with navigation dots requiring carousel decoration. Obvious match with carousel block.
Heading 'On Our Mind' and CTA link 'View all insights' - author can type heading and link normally.

Grid of 4 insight/article cards with structured repeating pattern: each has featured image, type label with icon, category tags, and article title. Requires structured block for grid layout and consistent card formatting.

candidateSections.backgroundAnalysis: The hero has its own embedded video that serves as the background/visual. The video player IS the hero design, not a section container background.
candidateSections.layout: Full-width content integrated with video player - edge to edge
candidateSections.reason: Background is the hero's own video/design element. Block type (hero) typically has intrinsic background styling.

step3eValidation.nonCandidateSections: Sections 2-8 all have light/white background with no distinct section-level styling that would require section-metadata. Sections 3, 6, 7 contain single blocks but have no distinct background color to warrant section-metadata.
